newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - July 9.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - July 9.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices stayed around their recent levels on Wednesday and traders said they expected the firmness to continue due to strength in the cargo market. Some suppliers said they would not lower bunker quotes as expectations for a local trader to support the cargo market, at least throughout this week, would boost sentiment in the bunker market.
